person_note: Numerous event passages independently expose Andrea as a participating “I” narrator, while dialogue containing “you,” “we,” or “I” was treated as local speech and two pronoun-light passages were left unmarked. The authorized opening independently sustains first-person narration, and scholarly whole-book analysis states that Andrea’s first-person narration continues throughout; two additional explicit sources agree. No evidence of a third-person frame, alternating sections, or another controlling person was found. The authorized prose source covers only the opening, but the interior quote evidence and whole-book structural sources remove the principal scope uncertainty.
